nodes.label: RSI(14) Real Chart — EUR/USD H1
nodes.description: Dual-panel chart showing real EUR/USD H1 candlestick price data (top panel, range ~1.1600–1.1800) and RSI(14) oscillator (bottom panel, range 0–100). RSI overbought line at 70 (red dashed), oversold line at 30 (teal dashed). RSI rises above 70 early (overbought, pink shading), then falls below 30 later (oversold, green shading). Demonstrates real-world RSI signal behavior on forex data.
